The market-keyed pricing fix (commit 98669cf) prevents recurrence; excluded picks are skipped by scoring, calibration, weight training, geometry, and Kelly sizing.

Old metric compared the unitless ensemble score (~15) with the realized return (%), so MAE printed 223% and within-5% drifted to 13.4% — a units mismatch, not model decay. New metric: |thesis expected_return_pct - realized return_pct| (return is direction-adjusted, so a winning short counts positive). Counters reset; old values preserved here.
